description: This Java source file defines the RegexpCondition class, which implements a conditional operation based on regular expression matching within the Apache OFBiz mini-language framework. It includes methods for evaluating regex conditions, executing sub-operations, and managing related metadata.

classes.name: RegexpCondition
classes.description: Implements a regex-based conditional check within the mini-language, evaluating whether a specified field matches a given regular expression and executing sub-operations accordingly.

classes.name: RegexpConditionFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of RegexpCondition based on XML element definitions.

methods.name: checkCondition
methods.description: Evaluates whether the specified field value matches the regex pattern expanded from the 'expr' attribute.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes sub-operations based on the result of the regex condition check.

methods.name: gatherArtifactInfo
methods.description: Collects artifact information from sub-operations for analysis or documentation.

methods.name: prettyPrint
methods.description: Generates a human-readable string describing the regex condition and its evaluation.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the RegexpCondition element.
